feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 May 2026 5:12pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 19 May 2026 at 4:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure west of Ireland, moving eastwards, with associated fronts and troughs crossing the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 5 or 6, veering West or Southwest later tonight and decreasing 4 or 5 for a time, then soon increasing Southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow morning. Then decreasing Southwest 4 or 5 late morning or early afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, but occasionally rough in southern and central parts of the area this evening.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain for a time this evening and tonight. Otherwise fair, although possibly hazy.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, possibly poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing mainly South or Southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow evening or at first overnight, although 4 or 5 in southeast of area. Little change thereafter.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, but slight in Liverpool Bay.


##Weather##

Rain for a time, then a risk of mist and fog patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain, poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches later.
